## Pipeline

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    in["data/in/interviews.json"] --> main["main.py — loop (fire CLI)"]
    main --> extract["extract.py — one Gemini call"]
    extract --> schema["schema.py — PatientLabels validation"]
    schema --> out["data/out/*.json — predictions"]
    out --> agg["aggregate"]
    agg --> ans["4 business answers"]
    ans --> qmd["README.qmd — plots/tables + pathway diagrams → GFM"]
```

Separation of concerns: `schema.py` defines the shapes, `extract.py` makes one LLM call,
`main.py` orchestrates the loop. Each run logs to `logs/` (loguru + LiteLLM debug), and
predictions are scored against the gold `_v3.ods` values on the 20-case validation split.
